publication.title: The first record of theropod dinosaur remains from the Angostura Colorada and Coli Toro Formations (Campanian–Maastrichtian) in the Ingeniero Jacobacci area (Río Negro Province, Argentina)
authors: K. Ulloa-Guaiquín, J. González-Dionis, F. Irazoqui

locality.name: PBDB collection 276643: The abelisaurid from the Angostura Colorada Formation was collected in 1956 near Cerro Yuquiche and belongs to a cluster of several dinosaur bones under the number MHJG 189 Pa.1–14, registered as “diverse fossil remains” by Casamiquela himself.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 276643 to Late Campanian with numeric bounds 83.6–72.2 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 93829; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 2048005 records Abelisauridae in collection 276643, linked by PBDB to reference 93829.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Abelisauridae indet. and the accepted name as Abelisauridae.
